title: RCE detection Nuclei template expansion: cover AutoPenBench WS5/WS6 and real-world CVE RCE tasks
goal: AutoPenBench WS5/WS6 (Remote Code Execution) and the real-world CVE tasks (Log4Shell, Spring4Shell, GeoServer, Jenkins, Drupal RCE) require comprehensive RCE detection. AegisPT uses Nuclei but may lack templates for all variants. Implement an RCE-focused Nuclei template expansion: (1) Ensure the following CVE-specific Nuclei templates are present and enabled: CVE-2021-44228 (Log4Shell), CVE-2022-22965 (Spring4Shell), CVE-2024-36401 (GeoServer), CVE-2024-23897 (Jenkins CLI RCE), CVE-2021-25646 (Druid RCE), CVE-2021-43798 (Grafana path traversal→file read), CVE-2019-16113 (Bludit RCE), CVE-2017-7494 (SambaCry). (2) Generic RCE detection: add Nuclei templates for: command injection via common parameters (cmd=, exec=, command=, ping=), PHP code execution via file inclusion, Server-Side Template Injection leading to RCE (math expression probe), deserialization gadget chain probe (URLDNS OOB). (3) OOB callback integration: configure Nuclei with an OOB server (Interactsh or self-hosted) so blind RCE (Log4Shell, SSRF→RCE) is detected via DNS/HTTP callbacks. (4) Verify Nuclei template database is up-to-date: run nuclei -update-templates in the assessment flow before each nuclei run. (5) Auto-match templates to discovered services: if nmap finds Jenkins on port 8080, only run Jenkins-specific templates. Reduces noise and scan time.
scope: AutoPenBench WS5/WS6 (RCE) + real-world CVE tasks. Current coverage depends on Nuclei template availability. OOB detection (Interactsh) is needed for blind RCE (Log4Shell). Template auto-matching to services reduces false scan overhead.
generation_reason: AutoPenBench WS5/WS6 + CVE RCE tasks need comprehensive Nuclei templates + OOB callback. Template auto-matching to nmap service fingerprints maximises efficiency.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Detection templates only. Never use Nuclei templates that deliver payloads or write files. OOB probe is DNS/HTTP callback only.
constraints.safety: Nuclei templates MUST be detection-only. No templates with 'attack' or 'body' payloads. Verify against existing safety validation from cve_template_generator.py.

success_criteria: All listed CVE templates verified present and enabled.
OOB/Interactsh configured for blind RCE detection (Log4Shell).
No regression in existing Nuclei tests.
